verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar exposes a Registrar API, so credential scoping is an applicable axis. However, the evidence pack documents no scoped or least-privilege tokens. The only relevant item is a community report that third-party DNS access required an API key with full access to the whole account, which is the opposite of least privilege.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
